checks.name: One row per Division I team
Net rating is offense plus defense
The average Division I team's net rating is near zero
Net ratings spread like team strength does (4 to 25 points per 100 possessions)
No team is implausibly far from average
Every team's tempo is between 55 and 82 possessions
No team has more rated games than games played
Every team has its own page address
Every team's record is the results listed on its page
Every final score is a basketball score (10 to 180 points a side)
Every linked opponent is a team with a page
The league terms are basketball-sized (efficiency 90 to 120, tempo 60 to 76, margin spread 7 to 16)
The top team is expected to beat a middle team on a neutral court, by a basketball score
Home court is worth between 1 and 6 points
The model's version and state are published
